properties.description: The reasoning_report walk and read: roots (a claim, or every top conclusion and contested Decision), the walk over premises, objections and the sides a contested Decision governs, each node's reading (truth, proof status, support with warrants, objections and how each stands, cited sources), and the summary lists: rests_on, uncited_premises, still_contested, contested_by_design, unsupported. Carries WHAT_THIS_MEANS.
